subject: SolaraCommerce MAP: handoff timeline & governance canvas
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@solaracommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SolaraCommerce MAP: handoff timeline & governance canvas

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for a great demo yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we can use to align on milestones, owners, and dates leading up to go-live. High level asks in this email:

- Please review the milestone dates in the attached XLSX and flag any conflicts.
- Confirm who on your side owns SSO & network provisioning (we have Marcus copied to help clarify).
- Pick a 60-minute kickoff slot (see proposed times in the sheet) so we can lock owners into calendar.

Quick context on what’s included in the MAP:
- Discovery acceptance (customer sign-off on data samples)
- Security questionnaire & evidence exchange (SOC/arch diagrams)
- Dedicated environment provisioning and routing
- Integration testing window (UAT) and go/no-go criteria
- Post-launch support bridge cadence

Attachments: Solara-MAP-v1.xlsx (master milestones), project-charter.pdf (scope + success criteria).

I’ve looped in Ben (CS lead) and Monica (implementation PM) who will run the timeline on our side. Looking forward to locking dates — naomi

--
Naomi Feldman

naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the detailed MAP. Quick answers:

- I own the business sign-offs and will coordinate with Marcus for the SSO/network side.
- Marcus: can you confirm whether our infra team can target the week of Aug 24 for dedicated routing and IP allowlisting?
- We also need to complete the security questionnaire. Please send the PDF and a short list of the evidence you’ll provide (logs, retention policy, SOC scope).

Two scheduling notes: the proposed kickoff times look fine but we prefer mornings ET. I’m copying our systems lead Marcus to resolve provisioning windows.

Thanks — Sofia

On Tue, Jul 20, 2026 at 11:01 AM Sofia Martinez <sofia@solaracommerce.com> wrote:
> Naomi — thanks; I own the sign-offs and will coordinate with Marcus for the SSO/network side.
> Marcus: can you confirm whether our infra team can target the week of Aug 24 for dedicated routing and IP allowlisting?

Thanks for the quick reply, Sofia — and welcome Marcus. Below is a concise owner/date ledger pulled from the MAP so we have a single place to confirm commitments before the kickoff: 

- Discovery acceptance: target 2026-08-07 — Owner: Solara (Sofia)
- Security questionnaire completion: target 2026-08-03 — Owner: Solara (Marcus + Security) / Redwood will provide evidence by 2026-07-28
- Dedicated environment & allowlisting: target window 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-28 — Owner: Solara infra (Marcus) + Redwood infra (Monica)
- Integration testing (UAT): 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-10 — Owner: Redwood (Ben) / Solara (Product QA)
- Go-live readiness review & sign-off: 2026-09-13 — Owner: Joint governance (Sofia + Naomi)
- Post-launch support bridge: 2026-09-13 to 2026-10-11 — Owner: Redwood CS (Ben)

Action items for this thread: 
1) Marcus: confirm Aug 24 provisioning window or propose alternative dates.
2) Sofia: confirm the internal owner for Discovery acceptance (name + best contact).
3) Marcus/Solara Security: we’ll upload the security-questionnaire.pdf and expected evidence list to the Drive link below by end of day 2026-07-21.

Proposed kickoff (60m): Wed 2026-07-28 10:00–11:00 AM ET or Thu 2026-07-29 09:00–10:00 AM ET — which works for you? Monica will send calendar invites once we confirm.

Attachments: Solara-MAP-v1.xlsx, project-charter.pdf, security-questionnaire.pdf (attached here). Drive: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1s0lARaMapDraft

Thanks — Naomi

Quick note from the CS side — thanks Naomi for pulling the ledger together. Two small clarifications before Monica issues invites: 

- For the UAT window (2026-09-06 to 2026-09-10) we recommend reserving two 3-hour test blocks (one smoke, one regression) the first two days to reduce risk. Will coordinate exact times with Solara QA.
- On the security evidence: Redwood will provide anonymized retention policy excerpts and a short sample of audit-log export by 2026-07-28. If Solara requires full-scope exports for compliance, let us know and we’ll route through GRC.
